total.description: Items the selection held when the run started.

failed.description: Items refused; the first 50 are in failures with a code.

currency.description: The store currency of every *Minor amount in sample (price runs); null otherwise.

sample.description: Before and after of the first 50 changes: prices (variantId, sku, beforeMinor, afterMinor), stock (variantId, locationId, beforeOnHand, afterOnHand), tags (customerId), status and publishing (productId).

code.description: price_changed, price_not_positive, stock_changed, below_reserved, not_found, retired, digital_stock, not_physical, revision_changed or needs_price.

data.description: Field values by key, typed as the custom-field HTTP contract: money as { amountMinor, currency } (integer minor units of the store currency).

published.description: Only a published language's market web addresses are served.

presences.description: Market web addresses in this language (`en-in`; `''` is the store's own URL).
